name: @subline/installer

scripts.//pack: Packaging is a CONFIG step, not a rewrite: build:mod produces build/mod, build:app produces dist, and electron-builder copies both. Signing and notarization are configured separately and deliberately absent here.

//engines: buildMod.mjs imports src/bundle/spec.ts directly, so that the checks the build runs and the checks the installer runs are the same code. Node strips TypeScript types without a flag from 22.18 on.

build.//extraResources: The mod bundle ships in Contents/Resources/mod and is COPIED OUT to ~/Library/Application Support/Subline/mod on install. It must never be loaded from here: see src/app/modInstall.ts — App Translocation would make the path vanish and stop Discord starting.

mac.//entitlements: A stable Team ID is what makes the App Management grant persist across our own updates (spec §4). Signing and notarization are a separate task and are intentionally not configured here.
